title: Towards Extracting Space Group Information From Experimental EBSD Patterns Using Unsupervised Domain Adaptation
content: Recent advances in combinatorial megalibrary synthesis show promise for enabling the screening of chemical spaces for nanomaterials with desired functional properties. After a megalibrary is synthesized, fast high-throughput crystallographic characterization methods are desired, which would identify the crystal symmetries of the phases present in the megalibrary. This would need to be done without using prior phase knowledge, due to the possibility of novel and previously unsynthesized phases in the megalibrary [1]. Afterwards, information on the crystal symmetries paired with composition information acquired through energy-dispersive spectroscopy could enable the downstream calculation of the nanomaterials’ functional properties.
